label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is a True Positive. User input retrieved via request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into a String.replace operation ('{{name}}', param) and is subsequently written to the HTTP response body via response.getWriter().println(body) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. The resolved sink value depends entirely on attacker-controlled input.

evidence.note: User input captured at L17, substituted into template at L21, and printed to response at L22 without encoding.
